# Gradiz Atelier

> Gradiz Atelier is a Miami event styling studio for luxury picnics, at-home proposals, birthdays, bachelorettes, room styling, bouquets and corporate events. It serves Miami-Dade County, Florida. Founder and event designer: Jasmine Gradiz.

Gradiz Atelier sets up before guests arrive and clears everything away afterward. Every booking is quoted individually; the prices below are starting prices shown on the website.

- Anniversary and romance picnics for date nights: from $250
- Marry Me and Be My Girlfriend proposal setups at home, on the beach or anywhere the client chooses (Intimate Yes, Signature Yes, The Gradiz Moment): from $449, $649 and $849, each with a light-up "Will you marry me?" or "Will you be my girlfriend?" sign, LED candles with red rose petals and red heart balloons
- Birthdays, bachelorettes and girls' soirées: from $550
- Corporate and brand events: from $950
- Hotel, Airbnb and home room styling: from $150
- Personalized bouquets: from $55; gift bouquets: from $80

Contact: 305-606-1191, reservations@gradizatelier.com. Open daily, 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Instagram and TikTok: @gradizatelier.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gradizatelier.com/): all experiences, add-ons, service area, FAQ and booking form
- [Marry Me and Be My Girlfriend Proposals](https://gradizatelier.com/proposals.html): the three proposal packages, what is and isn't included, add-ons and proposal FAQ
- [Design Your Bouquet](https://gradizatelier.com/bouquet-designer.html): build a bouquet stem by stem (25 to 150 stems), choose paper wrap, ribbon, satin banner and add-ons, see it in a top view or 360 view, and send the design to Gradiz Atelier for confirmation
